verdict.rationale: Omnara presents itself as an alternative to Claude Managed Agents and offers dashboard and API launch, a pricing page with a hosted bring-your-own-keys tier, and a $20/month paid service mentioned by the community. Together these suggest a hosted control plane. However, the evidence never states outright that Omnara-managed cloud compute runs the agents. The changelog fragment only implies an alternative to 'a machine you connect', and self-hosting is heavily emphasized. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party description of Omnara-hosted agent execution environments, documented managed-cloud scaling or limits, and independent hands-on corroboration of running agents with no user infrastructure.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use a managed cloud offering to run agents without operating my own backend infrastructure
